exposure: Gestational age at elective cesarean delivery
cohort: 14,447 singleton neonates delivered by elective cesarean section at Mater Mothers' Hospitals from 1998 to 2009
finding: Elective cesarean section performed at 37-38 weeks gestation is associated with poorer neonatal outcomes compared to those delivered at 39-41 weeks.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section (CS) performed at 37-38 weeks gestation is associated with poorer neonatal outcomes compared to those delivered at 39-41 weeks.
